features: ⚠️ THIS VERSION ADDS NO MIGRATIONS. The fill-in-by-hand Excel template arrives: the route for those whose old software cannot produce a usable export. You download it from the import screen, fill it in, upload it there — and from then on it is an import like any other.

ONE FILE, FIVE SHEETS — A cover and four lists: the units, the people with who owns what, the thousandths tables and the opening balances. Each sheet explains at the top what goes in it, including the two things nobody remembers a year later: that an empty cell in a thousandths table means «this unit does not take part», which is different from zero, and that in balances a positive amount means the unit owes the building.

YOU CHOOSE THE UNIT'S LABEL — «B1/1», «flat 3», «016»: it is the column that holds the four lists together, and must be repeated identically on the other sheets. Write it with one space too many and the row is not lost: it is matched anyway and you are told, instead of being discarded in silence.

A SHEET LEFT BLANK DOES NOT THROW AWAY THE OTHERS — This applies to Danea imports too. Before, any missing data stopped the chain at the first level that needed it, and everything below stayed out even when it did not depend on it: without the people sheet an import stopped at step four out of eight and left behind units, tables and balances that had been filled in. Now only what is really missing is missing, and when everything you provided has gone in, the outcome says «completed», no longer «interrupted».

SEVEN DEFECTS FOUND BY RE-READING THE CODE BEFORE RELEASING IT — An amount written «€ 120.50» with the symbol came in as zero, silently; «1.234» was read as one point two, a thousand times too small; a year written in place of a date created a financial year in 1905; two balance rows for the same person let only one in while the other vanished. All fixed, together with twelve more found in a second pass.

THE SCREENS AFTER THE IMPORT SAY WHAT TO DO — The balance-difference box gives advice in every one of its states, including when the file carries no total to compare against. Rows at zero no longer say «was already fine» but «not in your files», with the explanation and a link to the chart of accounts. And the PDF report no longer disappears: those who closed the outcome page without downloading it had no way back, and it is the document you attach to a handover.

EVERY HALF-FINISHED IMPORT, NOT JUST THE LAST ONE — Someone migrating three buildings, which at the start is the norm, was reminded of only one: the others sat in the archive with no screen naming them.
